_comment: Pipe-20 Phaser behavioural tunables. Values are NOMINAL until replaced by hardware measurements (docs/measurement_protocol.md).

ladder.stages.note: Stage count N (build constant; 12/16/18/20 selectable). Confirm by counting notches below 20 kHz (8.1).

ladder.mismatch_scale.note: Multiplier on the per-stage pole offset vector (ladder.stage_offset_cents) at Drive/matching = 1.

ladder.nl_a1.note: Junction-resistance term: omega_i = omega0 * (1 + a1*u + a2*u^2), u = stage input / nl_vref. Fit to the THD sweep (8.4).

ladder.nl_a2.note: Second-order junction term; sets sign and size of the level-dependent first-notch shift (8.4).

ladder.nl_vref.note: Sample value at which u = 1 (full scale = io.volts_at_fullscale).

mix.wet_level.note: Wet gain into the NORMAL / ALTERNATIVE sums (ideal complementary sum = 1).

mix.alt_mode.note: ALTERNATIVE derivation: 0 = dry - wet (sign flip), 1 = dry + output of stage mix.alt_tap_stage. Open question 10.3.

mix.alt_tap_stage.note: Stage whose output feeds ALTERNATIVE when mix.alt_mode = 1.

mix.vibrato_gain.note: Wet-only output gain in Phase/Vibrato mode.

control.fc_ref_hz.note: Expo converter reference: f_expo = fc_ref * 2^(V / volts_per_octave).

control.fc_sat_hz.note: 1/x generator compression: f_c = fc_floor + f_expo * fc_sat / (f_expo + fc_sat). Fit from the CV sweep (8.2).

control.smooth_ms.note: One-pole smoothing time constant on the summed control voltage.

control.coef_block.note: Engine samples between coefficient recomputes (1 or 8, spec 6).

cv.fullscale_volts.note: Sample value 1.0 on the CV bus = this many volts (ES-8/ES-9 class DC-coupled interface).

cv.attenuverter_max.note: Gain of the attenuverted CV input at +100 %.

lfo.slow_divisor.note: Rate divisor in L* slow mode (measure).

lfo.swing_volts.note: Peak LFO control voltage at Depth = 100 % (sweep = 2 * swing / volts_per_octave octaves).

lfo.centre_volts.note: Control voltage at the LFO midpoint (Depth = 100 % removes PITCH+CV, spec 3).

lfo.smooth_hp_hz.note: SMOOTH: one-pole high-pass corner on the LFO CV (8.6, within 20 %).

feedback.sign.note: +1 = positive feedback (peaks resonate), -1 = negative (notches resonate). Open question 10.2.

feedback.gain_max.note: Loop gain at Resonance = 100 %. Oscillation onset is at loop gain 1 => onset % = 100 / gain_max (8.3).

feedback.limit_level.note: Soft limiter (tanh) level in the loop, full-scale units; sets the oscillation amplitude (8.3).

feedback.hp_hz.note: AC-coupling corner in the loop (floor; see feedback.hp_ratio).

feedback.lp_hz.note: Loop low-pass corner in Hz when feedback.lp_ratio = 0 (op-amp roll-off / nice-screaming trim).

feedback.lp_ratio.note: If > 0 the loop low-pass corner tracks f_c (corner = ratio * f_c): fixes the oscillating mode across CV so the pitch tracks 1 V/oct (8.3). 0 = fixed feedback.lp_hz.

feedback.hp_ratio.note: If > 0 the loop high-pass corner tracks f_c (corner = max(feedback.hp_hz, ratio * f_c)), suppressing the near-DC mode the AC coupling would otherwise let through at high f_c. With lp_ratio this selects which loop mode f_c*tan(m*pi/N) oscillates (default: mode 1).

io.volts_at_fullscale.note: Peak volts represented by sample value 1.0 (Euro: 10 Vpk = +19.2 dBu). Maps dBu sweeps to dBFS.

oversample.resonance_pct.note: Auto: switch to the nonlinear-rate factor above this Resonance %.

oversample.input_db.note: Auto: switch to the nonlinear-rate factor above this INPUT setting (dB).

oversample.linear_factor.note: Engine rate factor when the nonlinearity is not engaged (1, 2, 4, 8). Bilinear warp of the top notch: see docs/DEVIATIONS.md.

oversample.nonlinear_factor.note: Engine rate factor when Resonance / INPUT exceed the thresholds (1, 2, 4, 8).
